author: blu
body: A real model file carries a key-value block between the header and the tensor table, so a parser that cannot step over that block cannot reach a single tensor. Until this section existed the chapter could read a header and nothing after it, and the tensor-info reader had to be handed an offset by a caller that had no way to compute one.

author: blu
body: A model announces what it is in its own metadata. gguf-metadata-text answers a string-valued key, or the empty text when the key is absent or holds something other than a string, so a caller reporting an architecture is quoting the file rather than its own expectation.
